body.statement: Fix \(\mathcal O_S\) generated by at least one member of \(\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{CA}}\). Joint Gaussianity and component alignment imply that the stacked disturbance vectors \((\varepsilon_i^{(a)})_{a\in M}\) are mutually independent across \(i\in V\). For every permutation \(\pi\), there exists a full joint component-aligned Gaussian completion with common order \(\pi\) and observed moments \(\mathcal O_S\) if and only if \(\operatorname{offdiag}(R_\pi^{ab})=0\) for every distinct \(a,b\in S\). When this holds, the structural coefficients are uniquely \(T_\pi\), each selected disturbance block \((R_\pi^{ab}[j,j])_{a,b\in S}\) is positive definite, and every \(\Gamma_{\pi,j}\) is a full positive-definite noise certificate. Consequently, \(\Theta_S(\mathcal O_S)\) is the complete coefficient equivalence class within \(\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{CA}}\).
body.justification: This supporting lemma supplies the fixed-order observable criterion and positive-definite completion used by the generic theorem and the complete-set algorithms.
body.gap: Section 4.6 of HeurtebiseEtAl2026LiMVAM is point-identifying under full pairing and its diversity assumption; this lemma instead records the orderwise residual characterization needed for selected pairing on the narrower component-aligned subclass, without treating that characterization as the principal novelty.
body.consumer: For coordinate-aligned repeated measurements satisfying the maintained mechanism, an analyst can determine exactly which shared orders and view-specific coefficient matrices remain licensed when only a calibration subset is aligned.
